PHYSICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

13. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

17. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.

19. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
